Create Sale Transaction.description: Records a sale and issues a tax-compliant receipt for it.

Calculate Transaction Totals.description: Calculates tax and totals for a sale without recording it.

Create Customer.description: Creates a customer party for use in sales.

Create Product.description: Adds a product to the inventory catalogue.

Reduce Product Quantity.description: Reduces stock for a product, e.g. for expiry or damage.

Initiate ZataPay Debit.description: Starts a ZataPay bank debit payment.

List Transactions.description: Lists sales transactions, page by page.

Get Payment Status.description: Checks the status of a ZataPay payment by reference.

List POS Products.description: Lists products available for sale at the point of sale.

List Payment Modes.description: Lists payment method ids to use in sale transactions.
